projects.solution: DRAFT — A modular landing page with a full-bleed brand moment at the top, editorial category blocks beneath it, and promotional slots that merchandising can swap without a designer.

projects.title: Adidas Brand Store
projects.shortDescription: A brand store landing page for Adidas on Myntra.
projects.description: Landing page design for the Adidas brand store on Myntra, built to carry Adidas’ performance-led identity through a marketplace layout.
projects.challenge: DRAFT — Adidas has one of the most tightly governed brand systems in the category. The page had to satisfy those guidelines and Myntra’s conversion requirements at the same time.
projects.approach: DRAFT — Treated the brand guideline as the constraint rather than the decoration: typography, spacing and the black-and-white base came first, merchandising modules were fitted around them.
projects.solution: DRAFT — A high-contrast landing page anchored by a hero campaign frame, with performance and lifestyle split into distinct scroll zones so both audiences find their entry point quickly.

projects.title: Roadster Grand Garage Sale
projects.shortDescription: Campaign landing page for Roadster’s Grand Garage Sale.
projects.description: A sale campaign for Roadster on Myntra — landing page, supporting banners and the promotional system that ran across the event.
projects.challenge: DRAFT — Sale events compress a lot of information into very little attention. The page had to communicate discount, category and urgency before a shopper decided to scroll.
projects.approach: DRAFT — Built the campaign around a garage-sale visual metaphor so the discounting felt like an event with a reason behind it, rather than a generic percentage banner.
projects.solution: DRAFT — A landing page with a strong campaign key visual, clear discount tiering, and a banner kit that extended the same language across app, email and social placements.

projects.title: Launch Event Key Visual
projects.shortDescription: Key visual and launch identity for an OLA product launch event.
projects.description: The key visual system for an OLA launch event, extended across stage, digital, social, print and retail touchpoints as part of the wider launch campaign.
projects.challenge: DRAFT — A launch key visual has to work at the scale of a stage backdrop and the size of a social tile, and stay recognisable across every surface in between.
projects.approach: DRAFT — Designed the key visual as a system rather than a single artwork: a core form, a defined colour behaviour and clear rules for how it crops at different ratios.
projects.solution: DRAFT — A launch identity that held together across event, OOH, digital and retail, giving campaign, product and retail teams one consistent visual to work from.

projects.title: Brand Identity Guidelines
projects.shortDescription: A brand guideline system built to scale across business units.
projects.description: A redesign of the brand guidelines, establishing a scalable visual identity that multiple business units could apply without diverging from each other.
projects.challenge: DRAFT — Several teams were producing work from different interpretations of the same brand, so the output had drifted apart across business units.
projects.approach: DRAFT — Wrote the guideline as a working tool rather than a reference document: rules stated as decisions people actually face, with examples of both correct and incorrect use.
projects.solution: DRAFT — A guideline covering logo, typography, colour, layout, photography and campaign application, structured so a new team can produce on-brand work without a designer in the room.

projects.title: Motion Graphics
projects.shortDescription: A selection of motion and animation work across campaigns.
projects.description: Motion graphics and animation produced across campaigns and product launches — explainer sequences, in-app moments and social cutdowns.
projects.challenge: DRAFT — Motion is usually the last thing produced and the first thing cut. It had to be fast to produce and consistent with static campaign work already in flight.
projects.approach: DRAFT — Built reusable animation principles — timing, easing and transition families — so new pieces could be assembled quickly instead of animated from scratch each time.
projects.solution: DRAFT — A motion language that extended the existing static identity into movement, applied across explainer video, in-app campaigns and social formats.
